svg.title: Yao 2009 tetramethylammonium hydroxide pentahydrate
svg.desc: Source-specific purchased reagent identity: tetramethylammonium hydroxide pentahydrate, TMAH, 99%, Acros. Formal composition C4H13NO dot five H2O. This formula card does not depict a hydrate lattice, ion pairing, or solution geometry. The amount is unreported.

g.text: SI p.1: purchased hydrate; SI p.2: methanolic MUA pH adjustment to ≈10.
